expected_response.basis: No permitted edit is connected to a supported coordinate observable with a defensible expected advantage; the strongest reproducible contrasts are diagnostic-only relative to the executing scalar.
expected_response.expected_effect: No change to the executing pointcloud scalar, teacher neighborhood, regional attention or temporal blend; the incumbent D2_without_trajectory_static program continues with pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, teacher_neighbors 4, mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 unchanged.
expected_response.primary_objective: Final predicted target affinity, evaluated separately from validity and strain.

failure_modes: An edit to pointcloud_delta_A would change only the robust curvature of the Hungarian endpoint-distance scalar, which contains no pair-kernel or shape term; the supported short-range pair-kernel and shape_yy contrasts would remain unaddressed, so no expected affinity advantage is established.

An edit to region_index or temporal_region_index would reweight Gaussian landmark attention only; landmark soft-min and occupancy signs are landmark-specific and heterogeneous, so a single-region emphasis could displace surrounding coordinates without a supported favorable direction.

An edit to teacher_neighbors would change a detached nearest-k teacher count, not a distance bandwidth; the information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092) and top4_teacher_overlap 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515), so narrowing or broadening the neighborhood is not supported as an affinity improvement.

An edit to temporal_teacher_blend would mix static and observed-node teacher coordinates; the supplied continuous contrast functions are noisy, sign-unstable and have rejected polynomial fits, so a time-conditioned blend is not validated and could act on unvalidated contrast.

Treating joint_innovation_RMS_A or joint_internal_RMS_A as a per-coordinate reward direction would be a category error: these are joint-motion diagnostics, not coordinate gradients, and no registered parameter acts on them.

Treating pair-kernel or shape-anisotropy effects as operative would be a category error: the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so those diagnostics cannot be compiled into the current program.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are on short-range pair-distance shell densities (endpoint_effects:9/10/11, positive_batch_fraction 1.0; branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241) and on shape anisotropy (endpoint_effects:3/4/8; branch_adjusted:158/235), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). The registered edit surface therefore cannot express the Analyst's leading hypothesis: pointcloud_delta_A changes only the robust curvature of the Hungarian endpoint-distance scalar, region_index/temporal_region_index change only Gaussian landmark attention weights, teacher_neighbors changes a detached nearest-k count, and temporal_teacher_blend mixes a static teacher with observed-node teacher coordinates. None of these is a pair-kernel or shape-anisotropy term, so an edit would not act on the observable the evidence supports. The remaining candidate directions are unsupported or sign-heterogeneous: global centroid contrasts are null (endpoint_effects:0/1/2; branch_adjusted:77/78/79), landmark soft-min/occupancy signs are landmark-specific (endpoint_effects:14/15/20/22/23/25/29/31/32/34/59/61/68/70), and the continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations with many sign changes and rejected polynomial fits (continuous:0-19; curve_support), so no constant or time-conditioned coordinate rule is validated. Joint-motion diagnostics (branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153/228/230/305/307; joint_diagnostics:1/2/11/14) are the most reproducible branch-adjusted effects but are explicitly joint-motion diagnostics, not a per-coordinate reward direction, and are not addressable by any registered parameter. Because the objective is affinity-first and the evidence provides no defensible expected advantage for any permitted edit, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; temperatures remain fixed (fixed_parameters) and no temperature edit is proposed.
